label: Litolff Beethoven 5 pp.1-4
adjudicator: Claude Opus 5, by eye, on 600-dpi crops of the gather's own render
blind: tile ids only; bucket, notehead class and control status were in a manifest that was NOT opened until after every verdict below was written

protocol.stem_printed_*: a stroke >=1.5 spaces attached at the head's side, OR the head unambiguously joined to a printed beam on that side
protocol.no_stem_printed: hollow or filled head with >=2 spaces of clean white above AND below and no stroke at either edge
protocol.not_a_notehead: the ink is clearly a rest, a barline, an accidental, script text, or a box on a vertical rule
protocol.cannot_tell: everything else. NOT converted into a definite answer.
protocol.side: which side of the head the stroke stands on - the direct test of Sean's convention
protocol.flags: up_excluded/down_excluded = >=2 spaces of clean white on that side, so that direction is ruled out even where the stroke cannot be seen
